nextcloud.description: Nextcloud Calendar is an open-source, self-hosted scheduling tool integrated into Nextcloud's ecosystem.

robotics.description: Policia is an autonomous robot using flood-fill navigation to chase a moving target through a known maze.

inar.description: A project which aims to build a robot face which can mimic human expressions.

gainpro.description: A unified proteomics pipeline for handling missing data imputation. Integrates traditional statistical baselines (MissForest) and deep generative models (GAIN and Autoencoder) in one place.

deep-learning.description: Deep Learning coursework (IST): Algorithms and models built from scratch in NumPy and PyTorch. Covering linear classifiers, MLPs, CNNs, Transformers, and ASR.

planning-learning-decision-making.description: Planning, Learning and Intelligent Decision Making coursework (IST): Algorithms and agents built from scratch in Python. Covering MDPs, Dynamic Programming, Q-Learning, Policy Gradients, and Deep RL.
